The Silence After Your Name Isn't On The List ! 
I've been through this. Tastes like poison.

A lot of you messaged me after my last post on my UPSC CSE journey. Some were just starting, some were confused about the strategy and some asked me about what next in life now ?

So let me be honest, not motivational.

It hurts like hell when you don't clear it. Anyone who says otherwise is selling you something.

Enter this battle field ONLY & ONLY IF 'YOU' WANT to fight back, and rise up again without counting, to win.

No one will come to rescue you. If it's NOT YOUR DREAM, don't fall for it.

My experience says, (irrespective of the selection) You'll become a version you never ever imagined. IT's MAGICAL Yet PAINFULL !

Before taking the final decision, get answers to these first.

1. Am i doing it for myself ?
2. Can i sacrifice social life (upto 90%) ?
3. Can i keep my mind at peace, when i see the peer group making money, doing jobs?
4. Can you promise yourself the exact same routine ( I mean it) for next 3 to 4 years ?
5. Can i handle my own self, if things go the other way ? 

Let me tell you this exam is all about everything else, except studies ( read again). And what we aspirants end up doing is attend classes, making notes, learning, test series and then clueless. 

Mansi Dabas Still flying.
comment: The overlooked part is building a parallel identity beyond the exam. A long preparation cycle becomes healthier when skills, relationships and career options keep evolving alongside the goal.
